crossRefs.note: Jephthah came to Mizpah to his house; and behold, his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances.…
As they came, when David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, the women came out of all the cities of Israel…
The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.
For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings…
Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself the pillar which is in the king’s valley, for he said…

people.name: Chedorlaomer
people.line: King of Elam, led coalition against Sodom and Gomorrah

people.name: King's_Valley
people.line: A valley near Salem (Jerusalem), site of significant events

people.name: Shaveh
people.line: Valley where Chedorlaomer defeated the Emites

people.name: Sodom
people.line: Wicked city destroyed by God for its sins

translations.web: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
translations.bsb: After Abram returned from defeating Chedorlaomer and the kings allied with him, the king of Sodom went out to meet him in the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
translations.kjv: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king's dale.
translations.asv: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him, after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings that were with him, at the vale of Shaveh (the same is the King's Vale).
